title: Pharmacy Benefit Plan Year-End Rules: Accumulator Reset and Fourth-Quarter Carryover
content:
On the first day of each plan year, the deductible and out-of-pocket accumulators of a Pharmacy Benefit Plan enrollment are each reset by one posting equal to the amount met at the close of the prior plan year, dated that first day.

## Fourth-quarter carryover

Where the design provides fourth-quarter deductible carryover, deductible amounts the member paid on claims dated from the first day of the design's carryover start month through the last day of the prior plan year are credited to the deductible, as a fourth-quarter carryover credit, on the first day of the new plan year. Out-of-pocket never carries over.

**The carryover months.** The carryover months run from the first day of the carryover start month through the last day of the prior plan year, counted in calendar dates.

**When and from what a carryover credit may be posted.** A carryover credit may be posted only on the first day of the new plan year or later — 0 days after that first day at the earliest, the first day itself included — and only from claims whose date of service falls in the carryover months of the immediately preceding plan year. Both are read from the enrollment's plan year start date and the accrual dates of the deductible postings in the accumulator ledger, matched to the claim.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical plan year beginning 1 January, carryover start month October)

The carryover months of the prior plan year are 1 October through 31 December.

| Date of service of the claim | In the carryover months of the immediately preceding plan year |
|---|---|
| 30 September of the prior plan year | No — the day before the carryover months begin |
| 1 October of the prior plan year | Yes — the first carryover day |
| 31 December of the prior plan year | Yes — the last day of the prior plan year |
| 1 January of the new plan year | No — it belongs to the new plan year |
| 15 November of the plan year before the prior one | No — not the immediately preceding plan year |

| Date the carryover credit is posted | Permitted |
|---|---|
| 31 December, the last day of the prior plan year | No — before the first day of the new plan year |
| 1 January, the first day of the new plan year | Yes |
| Any later date | Yes |

## Worked example (hypothetical member on a design with carryover)

At the close of the prior plan year the member had met 320.00 of deductible, 120.00 of it paid on claims dated 1 October through 31 December, and 900.00 of out-of-pocket. On 1 January the deductible is reset by one posting of 320.00 and out-of-pocket by one posting of 900.00. The 120.00 is credited to the new plan year's deductible as a fourth-quarter carryover credit dated 1 January. The member begins the new plan year with 120.00 of deductible met and no out-of-pocket met.

On a design without fourth-quarter carryover, the same member would begin the new plan year with no deductible and no out-of-pocket met.
